# Earth colour map (vendored)

`blue_marble_2048.jpg` is the NASA Blue Marble map that the project's Unreal scene uses for the Earth's disc (`unreal/Assets/earth/world.topo.bathy.200412.3x5400x2700.jpg`), reduced for the web. The 3-D ground view (`js/look3d.js`) puts it on the Earth's globe, so that the globe works offline.

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Source | Blue Marble Next Generation with topography and bathymetry, December 2004, 5400 x 2700 pixels; NASA Earth Observatory (Reto Stöckli), NASA Visible Earth, https://visibleearth.nasa.gov/images/73909 |
| Source file in this repository | `unreal/Assets/earth/world.topo.bathy.200412.3x5400x2700.jpg`, SHA-256 `a9f0088972dee0254610af851c4d6838ca3f2cf79176987e0a5713e2c15ec042` (see `CREDITS.md`) |
| Derived file | `blue_marble_2048.jpg`: resized to 2048 x 1024 pixels with a Lanczos filter (Pillow 13.0.0), saved as JPEG quality 88, progressive, 395 621 bytes |
| SHA-256 of the derived file | `5189fd3cebb90cf48495ae98aa92d6c695be9c776a9b3b7ab003ef6102834d97` |
| Projection | Equirectangular, longitude -180° at the left edge, as the source |
| Terms | NASA imagery, free to use with credit (NASA Images and Media Usage Guidelines: https://www.nasa.gov/nasa-brand-center/images-and-media/); no NASA logo or insignia used |

The map is turned so that the sub-lunar point of the direction table's `earth_view` record faces the observer and the Earth's north pole points along the package pole direction. It is for orientation only: the map is a cloud-free composite of December 2004 (snow and vegetation of that month), not the Earth at the time shown. Only the lit part (the phase) follows the time shown, from the Sun's package direction.

Do not edit this file. `web/tests/test_look3d.py` checks the checksum.
